title: Tilted picture wheel turning through a centred label
summary: About 22 square images ride a vertical wheel seen side-on, scaled 4x from far to near, crossing in front of and behind one centred line of type on white. One slow, even turn per loop; the line blurs in and out word by word.
use_when: a seamless loop for a gallery, template pack or asset library
showing many images or outputs around one short claim
a calm feature beat inside a longer film where depth comes from scale, not 3D
muted autoplay feeds that need constant motion without cuts

look.type_style: regular geometric grotesk, sentence case, normal tracking, black, ~48 px at 720p (6.7 % of frame height), one line centred

sfx.event: label words blur out at the loop point

structure.shot: white stage, image wheel already turning right of centre; a 5-word label names the technique, resolving left to right
structure.camera: static frame (locked; only the wheel moves)
structure.motion: label per word blur-in, stagger ~3 fr (human 30 fps study), easings.outExpo ~10 fr (±0.25 s); first word visible but soft at 0.27, last word sharp by 0.80–1.00; wheel easings.linear 34°/s from frame 0

structure.shot: label holds still at frame centre; ~11 distinct images (twice around, ~22 cards) turn on a vertical wheel, near cards cover the label's right end, far ones pass behind its left part
structure.camera: static frame (locked; only the wheel moves)
structure.motion: ItemWheel easings.linear 34°/s = one turn per 10.6 s (human 30 fps study); near side moves down 300–370 px/s, far side up 210–260 px/s at 720p; card size near ~230 px (0.32 H) to far ~56 px (0.078 H); no fade, no depth blur

structure.shot: the label dissolves word by word left to right while the wheel keeps turning; last frame matches frame 0
structure.camera: static frame (locked; only the wheel moves)
structure.motion: mirror of row 1: per-word blur-out, stagger ~3 fr (human 30 fps study), easings.inExpo ~10 fr (±0.25 s); first word soft at 9.77, gone by 10.00, label gone by 10.50; wheel continues linear

params.label: one line, about 5 words, sits at depth 0 inside the wheel
params.images: about 11 images, used twice around the wheel (~22 cards), square corners, no shadow
params.wheel.radius: vertical radius ~0.74 H (cards run off top and bottom)
params.wheel.tilt: ~71° about the vertical axis (half-extent 172 px of radius 533 px at 720p)

notes: One shot, 0 cuts (cuts.json empty), so every hand-over is continuous. Wheel numbers (34°/s, 0.74 H radius, 71° tilt, 4.1x scale range, +0.035 W axis, ~3 fr word stagger) are from a human 30 fps study; sheets at 4 fps confirm text in by ~0.8–1.0 s and out 9.7–10.5 s and a picture repeat every ~5.3 s. Entrance easing names are suggested (overshoot not measurable at 0.25 s). Reference is silent: all SFX are planned by the glue rule, not measured. Family is kinetic-type by elimination: the label is the anchor, no cut is the subject. Missing vocabulary term: image wheel interleaved with type (see Proposed terms in recipe.md).
